subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery?
rationale: The direction matches the existing manifest-first plugin boundary, but it freezes plugin API field names and affects host discovery around app-owned Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions.

options.title: Accept after PR cleanup
options.body: Regenerate the docs map, keep the contract metadata-only, and confirm host code treats the fields as discovery rather than authorization before merge.

options.title: Revise the contract shape
options.body: Change the field names, permission enum, platform shape, or MCP metadata before publishing the plugin API surface.

options.title: Pause or reject the contract
options.body: Keep the PR draft or close it if the macOS host discovery model is not settled enough for a public manifest contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after PR cleanup
recommendation.body: Regenerate the docs map, keep the contract metadata-only, and confirm host code treats the fields as discovery rather than authorization before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed ownership signal for plugin manifest metadata and docs surfaces.
